presentation.title: Big Update - Share your and view your village progress
presentation.summary: Clashboard just got more social! Introducing the new progress tab. Easily track all your Home village levels, and click the share button at the top to get a shareable image of your progress for lab or equipment (buildings and builder base coming soon).

sections.title: Event Support
sections.body: Clashboard now supports in game events, so that when there is a new event, it will be visible to you with all the details you need. Stay tuned for hammer jam, clashboard will show you the boosts provided by hammer jam, as well as all the details before it starts.

sections.title: iPhone Duo Support
sections.body: Clashboard supports the all new iphone duo, with a new layout that takes advantage of both the inner and cover screen, as well as the new UI that comes with it.
